fields.summary_ko.0: Palantir (PLTR) fell 5% following Q3 earnings release, with U.S. commercial total contract value (TCV) growth rate at 11% year-over-year, down sharply from 153% in the prior quarter.
fields.summary_ko.1: Total revenue nearly doubled year-over-year, breaking the $2 billion milestone for the first time, but shortened contract duration identified as key factor in growth deceleration.
